q: Why did we get fewer orders in the week of 19 October than the week before?
answer:
We had fewer orders in 2026-10-19→2026-10-25: orders fell from 210 to 184 (−12.4% vs the previous week), driven mainly by fewer customers rather than worse conversion or less ad spend. That means less volume of buyers, not a collapse in funnel performance.

What changed (ordered by impact)
- Customers (by order date): 201 → 167 customers (−17.0%); the diagnosis flags this drop as a supported cause — the fall in customers explains most of the orders shortfall.  
- Orders and value: Orders 210 → 184 (−12.4%); Total sales ₹5,27,337 → ₹4,39,982 (−16.6%).  
- AOV / basket: AOV fell slightly ₹2,511 → ₹2,391 (−4.8%), so lower basket size amplified the sales drop but was a smaller contributor to the order count decline.  
- Ad spend: ₹2,98,777 → ₹3,00,853 (+0.7%) — ad delivery did not fall (it edged up) and is ruled out as the cause.  
- Sessions / traffic: Sessions per day were lower (diagnosis shows a drop) but the engine ranks customers falling as the supported cause; sessions moved together with ads and cannot be isolated as a cause from the available data.

Worth checking:
- Which channels/campaigns lost new or returning customers (the engine flagged a few campaign-level drops as notable) — this will show whether the customer loss is concentrated or broad.
- PDP / product-level availability or listing changes (PDP page views were not available for this scope) — missing PDP data means we can't confirm product-page issues.

Period: 2026-10-19..2026-10-25 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-28
